label: A. Scarlatti: Fugue in F minor
caution: Read by the program from Gouin's typeset edition, notes and voices both, then proofread on 2026-11-23 against Roseingrave's London print and a Paris print of the 18th century. Where both old prints agree against Gouin it follows them: two bars Gouin lacks after his bar 33, a handful of notes, and the minor ending. Some lines are in the wrong voice.
title: Alessandro Scarlatti: Fugue in F minor
procedures: a voice held back until after the exposition

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted, in a sequence rising by a third every half bar. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 20–25). Returns in Episode 6 (bars 49–63). Returns in Episode 7 (bars 67–76). Returns in Episode 9 (bars 83–89).
sections.leads: From F minor to C minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bar 12) in part, with the soprano's line in the tenor, the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject. Tenor: free counterpoint. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a fourth every half bar.

sections.label: Episode 6
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bar 12) in part, with the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject and the opening of the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted and the opening of the subject, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: the opening of the subject and a figure from the subject, inverted. Returns in Episode 8 (bars 79–80).

sections.leads: From F minor to B♭ minor; perfect cadence in F minor at bar 68; perfect cadence in C major at bar 73; perfect cadence in B♭ major at bar 74; perfect cadence in A♭ major at bar 75

sections.leads: From B♭ minor to F minor

sections.leads: Between two statements in F minor; perfect cadence in C major at bar 85
